# Stable Video Diffusion (SVD, 14 frames)

Stability AI · released 2023-11

Image-to-video model requiring a starting image; not text-to-video. Original release, distinct from SVD XT 1.1. Place a starting image at input.png. CUDA GPU plus system RAM required for CPU offload. 8GB VRAM is a planning estimate based on the documented chunking/offload setup; not a local measurement.

[Model and usage documentation](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid)

[Catalogue source](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid/blob/9cf024d5bfa8f56622af86c884f26a52f6676f2e/README.md)

No reviewed benchmark results yet. This catalogue entry has no score or rank.

## How to run it

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (fp16 · CPU offload, needs ~8 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/docs](https://huggingface.co/docs/diffusers/main/en/using-diffusers/svd))
   
   ```sh
   uv run --with torch --with diffusers --with transformers --with accelerate --with imageio-ffmpeg python -c "import torch; from diffusers import StableVideoDiffusionPipeline; from diffusers.utils import load_image, export_to_video; p=StableVideoDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained('stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid', torch_dtype=torch.float16, variant='fp16'); p.enable_model_cpu_offload(); p.unet.enable_forward_chunking(); image=load_image('input.png').resize((1024,576)); frames=p(image, num_frames=14, decode_chunk_size=2).frames[0]; export_to_video(frames, 'video.mp4', fps=7)"
   ```

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/stabilityai](https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid)
